classification.difficultyReason: Translate related walking and running speeds into one equation, converting minutes to hours.

content.prompt: In an effort to catch a bus, I walked for 10 minutes and ran for 5 minutes. I know I can run 4 times as fast as I can walk. What was my running speed, in km/h, if I travelled a total of 3 km to catch the bus?

answer.worked:
Let $v$ km/h be the walking speed. The running speed is $4v$ km/h. The walking and running times are $\frac{1}{6}$ hour and $\frac{1}{12}$ hour respectively. Using distance = speed × time:

$$\begin{align*}\frac{v}{6}+\frac{4v}{12}&=3\\\frac{v}{6}+\frac{v}{3}&=3\\\frac{v}{2}&=3\\v&=6\\4v&=24\end{align*}$$

The running speed was $24\text{ km/h}$.
